description.narrative: Core support to a non-governmental organisation with the purpose to monitor and analyse the geo-political situation in Jerusalem. Terrestrial Jerusalem's focus is to influence Jerusalem-centric policy with three goals in mind: 1) to prevent harmful developments that could ignite crises and derail prospects for a political solution, 2) to promote constructive, affordable and achievable interventions that can stabilise the situation and 3) to develop medium and long-term strategies that will contribute to a sustainable two-state solution.

Kärnstöd till en civilsamhällesorganisation med syfte att följa och analysera den geopolitiska situationen i Jerusalem. Terrestrial Jerusalem avser att influera Jerusalem-centrisk policy med tre huvudmålsättningar: 1) att motverka skadlig utveckling som skulle kunna generera kriser och omöjliggöra en framtida tvåstatslösning; 2) främja konstruktiva, kostnadseffektiva och möjliga åtgärder som kan stabilisera situationen; och 3) utveckla strategier som kan bidra till en hållbar tvåstatslösning.

The overarching objective of Terrestrial Jerusalem's activities is to: protect the political, religious, territorial and cultural character of Jerusalem; to promote a just, equitable and sustainable political settlement to the Israeli-Palestinian conflict that respect the rights of all its residents; and to safeguard prospects for realizing a two-state solution.

sector.narrative: Civilian peace-building, conflict prevention and resolution

description.narrative:
For The Cooperation Partner , the operational context was marked by the war in Gaza and violence on the West Bank and its effects on Jerusalem, in particular through increased restrictions on Palestinian movement, political expression and access to religious sites, in particular the Holy Esplanade. Further, religious extremism played a growing role in the conflict dynamics of Jerusalem, with Temple Mount Movements, ultra-nationalist Israeli settlers and Hamas narratives centering Jerusalem as the symbolic battleground. In this context, the Status Quo at the holy sites have been further eroded, with an increased Jewish presence at Al Aqsa, and attacks on Christian institutions and clergy. Lastly, results of the US presidential elections in November had a major impact on US policy vis-a-vis Jerusalem, making it more difficult to engage with the White House during the last quarter of 2024.
One of the major efforts undertaken by The Cooperation Partner during 2024 was the advocacy aimed at the G7 with the goal of securing a statement that would reaffirm commitments to the status quo at religious sites, Palestinian presence in East Jerusalem, and diplomatic engagement in the city's governance. This initiative was undertaken by The Cooperation Partner in order to re-insert Jerusalem into the international diplomatic agenda and safeguard the city's multi-faith character. Despite initial success and strong expression of support from several European and Middle-Eastern stakeholders expressed strong support for the initiative, as did religious leaders. The initiative was well received in preliminary diplomatic engagements and positioned for further negotiations within the G-7 framework.
However, despite the initial momentum G-7 declaration ultimately did not materialize due to shifting geopolitical priorities and political uncertainty not least in light of the election of president Trump. The G-7 initiative is indicative of the specific character of the The Cooperation Partner intervention, which provides ample opportunities that can have an out-sized impact relative to their costs, but whose success is heavily dependent upon 1) Political developments in the U.S and European capitals and 2) The Cooperation Partner 's ability to access high-level decision makers in those capitals. Nevertheless, The Cooperation Partner assesses that there is a broad agreement between the EU and various states that the declaration should be revisited at an alternative venue.
The Cooperation Partner has engaged in other types of high-level advocacy and diplomatic engagements including with high-level White House and officials of the US state department and members of congress, EU officials, European foreign ministers, UN agencies and Canadian officials. The Cooperation Partner has also engaged in policy research and development, including the tracking of settlement expansion and home demolitions and status quo violations at holy sites.
In light of increasing religious extremism, and worrying political narratives concerning the holy sites of the city, The Cooperation Partner has also made considerable efforts to preserve Jerusalem's historical, political, cultural and religious character. They have developed an extensive database cataloging key Jewish, Muslim, Christian and heritage sites in the Old City and the Old City Basin. The database is in the process of being developed into an interactive website which will underscore Jerusalem's shared heritage and combat religious extremism.
Lastly, The Cooperation Partner has continued to produce it's podcast Axis Mundi, producing 7 episodes in 2025 on a wide-array of topics related to Jerusalem.
In general, given the absence of indicators and logical frameworks, in combination with the fact that The Cooperation Partner is heavily reliant on political advocacy, it is difficult to describe any outcome or impact in concrete terms. It is clear however, that given the right political environment, The Cooperation Partner has the potential to influence key figures and decision-makers for a relatively low cost.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
